title: ranunculus adunans
intro: Ranunculus adunans, commonly known as the sharp-leaved buttercup, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and acting as an antiseptic to promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus adunans include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, making it useful in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
